description: As a developer I want to verify LLM configuration through the health endpoint so that I can ensure the application uses the correct model

acceptance_criteria.description: Health endpoint returns LLM provider and model details
Endpoint returns status 'ok' when LLM configuration is valid

description: As a developer I want the database health endpoint to report database unavailability without crashing the application so that the system can continue running

acceptance_criteria.description: Database health endpoint returns 503 status code on database failure
Error message includes the exception type and message
